title: com.docker.sandbox/git-push@1
description: Bounds on what the sandbox may push over Git: remotes, refs by pattern, deletions, and what every pushed commit must carry. Each field narrows; an omitted field leaves that dimension unbounded, and a config stating nothing is an error. Singleton; contributions intersect. A pattern is a literal with at most one *, which matches any sequence of characters including /. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move.

remotes.description: host/owner/repo patterns the sandbox may push to, such as github.com/docker/*. Omit to allow every remote; an empty list is an error.

refs.description: Fully qualified ref patterns a push may update. Exclude wins; an absent include admits every ref not excluded.

delete.description: Whether a push may delete a ref. Omit for the runtime's default.

commits.description: What every pushed commit must carry.

signed.description: require refuses a commit without a signature made through the sandbox's agent grant; prefer records the absence; ignore does not look.

trailer.description: require refuses a commit whose Sandbox-Id trailer is missing or names another sandbox; warn forwards it and records the gap.
